title: Resident Evil 3: Nemesis/Secrets
text:
If the player beats the game, depending on rank, they get up to five secret costumes.
A rank gets all five alternate costumes
B rank gets four of the five
C rank gets three of the five
D rank gets two of the five
E rank gets one of the five
F rank gets none
Note that all ranks are cumulative so if you get a B on one game and the next round you get an E you'll have all five.
Nemesis is basic if you know what weapons to use.
He's weak against freeze rounds, it'll take eight to gun down his first form. Then seven more when he gets back up.
The Boutique is next to the bar jack where you can change into any outfit you wish.
